summary: Women Empowerment - Exhibition of Handmade & Consumer Products by 120 + Women Entrepreneurs.
description:
Women Empowerment - Exhibition of Handmade & Consumer Products by 120 + Women Entrepreneurs.
Our Club, since several years, is supporting Sion Bhagini Samaj for organising an Exhibition of Handmade and Consumer Products by Women Entrepreneurs at Sion Bhagini Samaj, Sion West.
Our Club will be continuing its support in the current year too.
Project cost Rs. 40,000/-
